name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: A pagination component with basic, rounded, and group variants. Supports asChild for link-based navigation. Uses namespace exports: Pagination.Root, Pagination.Item, Pagination.NavButton, Pagination.NavIcon.

docs.lead: A pagination component with three visual variants and support for both button and link-based navigation.
docs.usage:
import * as Pagination from "@/components/ui/pagination"

<Pagination.Root>
  <Pagination.NavButton>
    <Pagination.NavIcon as={RiArrowLeftSLine} />
  </Pagination.NavButton>
  <Pagination.Item current>1</Pagination.Item>
  <Pagination.Item>2</Pagination.Item>
  <Pagination.NavButton>
    <Pagination.NavIcon as={RiArrowRightSLine} />
  </Pagination.NavButton>
</Pagination.Root>
